correctness.rationale: The glued H is C1, radially strictly increasing and proper with no critical point off 0; every positive energy level is one regular closed orbit. The X Hamiltonian sign is consistent on the switch and all periods use original physical time. Upper x^2=(2E-y^2)/(1+2a y^2) yields T+=2K(-4aE) and the stated upper area expression, while lower y=u z with u^2+2b*u^4=2E gives time/area beta integrals. Independently evaluated B(1/4,3/2)/B(1/4,1/2)=2/3 to 30-digit precision, and upper elliptic K/E formulas numerically at E=10^6 and E=10^10 showed the expected slow approach to log-leading constants. The identity dA±/dE=T± follows by moving-boundary differentiation. Dominated convergence on lower z in [0,1] with integrable (1-z^2)^-1/2 dominating density proves the Beta normalization; truncated upper integrations to Y=E^(v/2) yield v times log E and uniform logarithmic height under both conditional measures. Fixed positive a,b and E->infinity; finite numerics are corroboration only.
